## Question and requested delivery

<!-- State the question/problem and its scope, without prescribing a research
answer. Name the requested contribution: research/comparison, argument
integration, or tooling/documentation/maintenance. Separate mixed promises. -->

## Target and current baseline

<!-- Name the target statement/argument and selected sense, or the affected
component. Link the current main revision, reusable results/definitions,
attempts, notes and issues/PRs. Identify what is already delivered.
Mark any proposed bridge OPEN and name its exact missing step. -->

## Live uncertainty and approach

<!-- What remains unresolved? For research, state the strongest relevant rival
and a discriminating test, or why no substantive objection is identified.
Suggest useful paths without a proof quota or a fixed depth. -->

## Acceptance evidence

<!-- List concrete acceptance items and relevant checks. A research finding may
complete a research scope. Promised integration needs its canonical argument,
full premise bundle and actual use toward the target; a connection plan alone
is partial. An existing consumer or the target itself suffices. For tooling,
name observable behavior. Retained open premises do not prevent delivery. -->

- [ ]

## Reconciliation and continuation

<!-- Name the affected current assessment/next test and existing note/handoff,
or explain why none is affected. At dispatch, refresh against main. On delivery,
link reviewed evidence, distinguish completed scope from remaining work, and
record the next distinct test or reopening condition. Preserve historical
findings. Partial delivery does not close unfinished acceptance items. -->
